title: Student Grievance Redressal
content:
DAVIET has a Student Grievance Redressal mechanism for academic and non-academic matters (including victimization, attendance, fees, examinations/assessment, library, central facilities, hostel/mess/canteen, and harassment-related issues), aligned with AICTE student grievance regulations as stated on the official page.

Published procedure summary:
1. Submit the complaint in writing to the mentor (mentor should resolve within 2 days).
2. If unresolved, it goes to the Grievance Redressal Committee chairperson; committee meeting within 2 days; aim to resolve within a week.
3. If unsatisfied, appeal to the Principal within a week of the committee decision.

Students may also submit grievances personally in the Dean (Student Affairs) office, to committee members, via suggestion boxes (Reception/Library/Canteen/Hostels), or by email.

Published grievance email: studentsgrievance@davietjal.org (also referenced as studentgrievances@davietjal.org on the Functional Committees page).

Related bodies mentioned on the site include Discipline Committee, Internal Complaints Committee (for sexual harassment matters), and Anti-Ragging Committee/Cell.
